articles.title: Shoprite Holdings Ltd's Dividend Analysis
articles.summary: Shoprite Holdings Ltd (SRGHY) recently announced a total dividend of $0.35 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-25. This payout consists of a $0.35 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-10-08. As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
